uncited: Training Ray Shuffling initializes the training data pipeline by generating a random permutation of ray indices and transferring them to the GPU for efficient batched sampling during differentiable volume rendering optimization.

It differs from its parent [Batch Ray Sampling](2767-batch-ray-sampling.md) by explicitly handling the permutation logic and GPU transfer, and from its sibling [Pixel Batching](3134-pixel-batching.md) by operating on the ray index level rather than pixel-level aggregation.
- **When to Use:** Standard differentiable volume rendering training where ray order randomization is required.
- **When Not to Use:** When deterministic ray ordering is needed for reproducibility or specific spatial sampling strategies.
Originating from implementations in DirectVoxGO and Clear-plenoxels, this method is part of the broader NeRF training loop setup.
